aggregate_claim.fact: The declared bounded population has the reported structural reconciliation result under this profile and cutoff.
aggregate_claim.qualification: FULLY_SUPPORTED if evidence establishes the scoped result; CONDITIONALLY_SUPPORTED with named conditions only for accepted declared-only authority. A supported negative result is not an affirmative delivery claim.

aggregate_rules.FAIL: At least one frozen positive fail condition. Absence alone never FAIL.
aggregate_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: Neither PASS nor a positive FAIL condition established.
aggregate_rules.PASS: Population closed, conserved, nonempty eligible obligations, no missing issuer/rule evidence, every obligation CONFIRMED, no positive fail condition. Empty/all-excluded PASS not permitted.

authority_processing: DECLARED_ONLY observer bindings permit structural processing but positive claim support is INDETERMINATE/CONDITIONALLY_SUPPORTED with authority_binding_declared_only. Unknown observer/binding is unresolved trust, not proof of non-delivery.

acder_bounded.rule: Requirement-derived bounded evidence profile above. No full standard, production, real-world truth or external independence claim.

integrity_only.rule: Hash exact named payload bytes; SUPPORTED on all matches, REFUTED on a mismatch. All other query kinds NOT_APPLICABLE.

naive_ack.rule: Any payload for the same instruction_id with kind transport_ack or receiver_observation and outcome ACCEPTED/QUEUED/RECEIVED yields SUPPORTED, ignoring target, content, boundary, authority, enforcement and effect bindings. For a population query, any successful ACK for an included instruction suffices. Otherwise INDETERMINATE/NOT_SUPPORTED, never REFUTED solely for absent ACK. Conditions empty; this deliberately loses qualifications.

claim_definitions.all_required_delivery: Every obligation for every manifest instruction in the query scope is CONFIRMED, with closed resolution and preserved population. No vacuous all-target success.
claim_definitions.complete_mediation: All required delivery supported AND accepted verified coverage for all paths in the declared deployment scope AND required authority; named-member delivery alone is insufficient.
claim_definitions.effect_observed: A valid observation establishes the exact requested predicate, operation/target, method and window. Other operations or windows cannot satisfy it.
claim_definitions.enforcement_applied: An attributable native APPLIED assertion for the exact target/control/effective boundary. No independent runtime-state, completion or effect claim.
claim_definitions.envelope_integrity: Every named record payload hashes to its stated digest; no event truth implied.
claim_definitions.execution_observed: An attributable boundary_crossing observation establishes only the named operation entering provider-entry. It does not establish execution completion or effect.
claim_definitions.issuer_dispatched: Valid issuer emission observation establishes crossing of issuer-egress for the exact instruction.
claim_definitions.ordering: The requested before/after relationship is established by the same accepted clock domain or declared accepted causal link.
claim_definitions.population_complete: Independent population manifest, included instruction IDs and available instruction metadata agree under the frozen rule; this is bounded issuer-population completeness, not deployment coverage.
claim_definitions.receiver_receipt: Valid target-bound observation of reading/matching the exact instruction at target-entry. This independent receiver fact can be supported while missing issuer evidence leaves its obligation INDETERMINATE.
claim_definitions.semantic_preservation: The named transformation preserves every relevant source state distinctly and retains source provenance; an identity envelope hash alone cannot establish this.

clock_rules.mono: One stipulated monotonic ordering domain. Compare numeric times only within this domain. Different clock IDs without explicit accepted causal link do not establish ordering.

condition_rule: A sorted unique set of applicable missing predicates/limitations from the fixed vocabulary. Conditions do not substitute for mandatory evidence. Positive supported bounded claims need no conditions; their scope remains explicit in the query.

disposition_rules.CONFIRMED: All structural bindings, issuer observation and valid matching receiver observation established.
disposition_rules.CONFLICT: Otherwise verified applicable observations make irreconcilable assertions.
disposition_rules.EXPLICIT_FAILURE: Positive verified failure bound to exact instruction, attempt, target and relevant boundary.
disposition_rules.INDETERMINATE: Required issuer observation missing or applicable required trust/reference unresolved, unless a preceding positive condition controls.
disposition_rules.INVALID: Positive malformed native record or required structural binding absent, or envelope digest verification failed.
disposition_rules.SUBSTITUTION: Applicable same identity scope/instruction/attempt records disagree on governed content, including issuer/receiver. Preserve all records.
disposition_rules.UNCONFIRMED: Expected obligation has issuer observation but no valid matching receiver observation at cutoff.

hash.input: UTF-8 bytes of payload_utf8, with no additional newline
hash.meaning: payload byte integrity only; no signer identity, event truth, authority, or semantic equivalence

payload_serialization.consumer: hash exact payload_utf8 before JSON parsing; canonical reserialization is not the verification input
payload_serialization.producer: JSON sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, ensure_ascii=false

population.coverage: VERIFIED and evidence_refs nonempty is an accepted synthetic coverage basis. DECLARED_ONLY permits named-member accounting only; no complete-mediation assertion.
population.expected_instructions: Independent frozen population.manifest_instruction_ids; never derive from received records.
population.missing_instruction_metadata: Account expected instruction as target_resolution_unclosed; create no synthetic obligation; retain missing metadata diagnostic.
population.unclosed_resolution: No synthetic obligation; prevents PASS for dependent aggregate.
population.valid_exclusion: Rule/version match frozen population.exclusion_rule; input_basis permitted; applied_time <= frozen rule time. Invalid outcome-adaptive exclusions do not remove candidate targets.

receiver_accounting: Only receiver_observation records enter receiver counts; each appears once. matched means correlated eligible record, not a second confirmation count. Diagnostics do not add counts.
receiver_correlation: Same instruction_id + identity_scope + attempt_id + expected target_id. A malformed required binding can remain correlated when the other identity fields identify the obligation; target mismatch is ORPHAN. Content mismatch remains correlated and is SUBSTITUTION.
refutation_rule: REFUTED requires positive contradictory evidence for the exact proposition/scope. UNCONFIRMED, INVALID or absence does not itself prove the proposition false.
scope: Synthetic bounded evidence evaluation; no wire-format, production runtime, native signature verifier, or complete ACDER implementation claim.
semantic_mapping_rule: For the supplied native state vocabulary, every relevant state must have a distinct destination with the same declared meaning. This benchmark uses identical native/canonical state names; a nonidentity or many-to-one mapping is positive nonpreservation.

state_qualification.INDETERMINATE: CONDITIONALLY_SUPPORTED only for declared-only authority/coverage with otherwise supporting structural evidence; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED

trust_limit: VERIFIED is accepted synthetic profile configuration, not cryptographic verification of real-world identity. All fixtures and observations are authored by one owner.
